dataset_purpose: The dataset is designed to track and analyze sales transactions, profitability, and market performance across various product categories, regions, and customer segments.
business_objectives: Maximize overall profitability by identifying high-margin product categories and segments.
Optimize discount strategies to ensure promotional activities do not erode net profit margins.
Analyze regional sales performance to identify growth opportunities and optimize supply chain allocation.
Evaluate product-level performance to inform inventory management and procurement decisions.
Segment customers to tailor marketing strategies and improve customer lifetime value.

data_dictionary.description: Unique identifier for each customer order.
data_dictionary.business_meaning: The primary transaction reference number used to track orders and group multiple line items within a single purchase.
data_dictionary.usage: Used as a primary key for joining with shipping or returns data and for counting total transaction volume.

data_dictionary.description: The calendar date when the transaction occurred.
data_dictionary.business_meaning: The temporal marker for the sale, used to determine fiscal periods, seasonality, and growth trends.
data_dictionary.usage: Primary dimension for time-series analysis, trend forecasting, and period-over-period comparisons.

data_dictionary.description: The geographical territory where the sale was made.
data_dictionary.business_meaning: The administrative or market area (e.g., North, West) responsible for the revenue generation.
data_dictionary.usage: Used for geographic segmentation and regional performance benchmarking.

data_dictionary.description: The high-level classification of the product.
data_dictionary.business_meaning: Broad product groupings such as Technology or Furniture used for strategic portfolio management.
data_dictionary.usage: Used to aggregate sales and profit metrics at a macro level for executive reporting.

data_dictionary.description: The specific name or model of the item sold.
data_dictionary.business_meaning: The granular product entity that the customer purchased.
data_dictionary.usage: Used for SKU-level performance analysis and identifying best-selling items.

data_dictionary.description: The gross monetary value of the transaction.
data_dictionary.business_meaning: Total revenue generated from the sale before expenses are deducted.
data_dictionary.usage: The primary measure of business scale and top-line growth.

data_dictionary.description: The net financial gain or loss from the transaction.
data_dictionary.business_meaning: The amount remaining after the cost of goods sold (COGS) and other expenses are subtracted from sales.
data_dictionary.usage: The critical metric for assessing business viability and bottom-line health.

data_dictionary.description: The reduction applied to the list price of the product.
data_dictionary.business_meaning: The promotional incentive offered to the customer, expressed as a decimal or percentage.
data_dictionary.usage: Used to analyze the impact of pricing strategies on sales volume and profit erosion.

data_dictionary.description: The classification of the customer type.
data_dictionary.business_meaning: The market segment the buyer belongs to, such as Corporate, Consumer, or Home Office.
data_dictionary.usage: Used for targeted marketing, CRM analysis, and understanding different buyer behaviors.
